title: Pearl Nugget Hoops
descriptionHtml:
A pearl, held in a glitter of gold. Small gold hoops whose lower curve is crowded with short faceted gold beads, slightly jumbled so the edge catches light, cradling one round white pearl inside each hoop. Hinged lever backs.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with a crisp white shirt or a silk blouse.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 22mm across
  • Pearl: One round white pearl, approximately 10mm, inside each hoop
  • Detail: Lower curve set with short faceted gold beads
  • Closure: Hinged lever back
  • Finish: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
